newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corporate bonds drift lower, mart watches Fed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corporate bonds drift lower, mart watches Fed.

text.p: U.S. high-grade corporate bond prices were marginally weaker in lackluster trade at midday, as players limited moves ahead of Tuesday's Federal Open Market Committee meeting, dealers said.

Turning to high-yield trade, prices were firm and unchanged in spotty activity, according to junk desks. Gaming sector paper garnered some interest, one trader said, with Harrah's Jazz Co debt rising one to two points.
The Harrah's Jazz 14-1/4 percent first mortgage notes were quoted at 54 bid, 57 offer near mid-session.
